title: Engineering as Code: Bringing Software Engineering Methodology to Engineering Design
abstract: arXiv:2609.04216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have made significant progress in verifiable domains such as code generation and chip design, yet remain limited on engineering design tasks in fields like architecture, mechanical engineering, and HVAC. This paper argues the root cause is not model capability but the absence of a "Design as Code" computable foundation: design representations that can be consumed, verified, and versioned by machines. Existing CAD/BIM systems couple design logic with geometry, causing quality assurance to drift downstream; Automated Compliance Checking (ACC) suffers from geometric false positives and naming-dependent model reconstruction overhead. We propose the Engineering as Code (EaC) paradigm: expressing engineering design as text-native declarative language with automated rule engines, version control, and package management as quality gates. Core contributions: (1) the Information Representation Hypothesis, arguing the engineer

translated_title: 工程即代码：将软件工程方法论引入工程设计
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在代码生成和芯片设计等可验证领域已取得显著进展，但在建筑、机械工程和暖通空调（HVAC）等领域的工程设计任务上仍然能力有限。本文认为，其根本原因不在于模型能力，而在于缺乏“设计即代码”的可计算基础：即能够被机器消费、验证和版本化的设计表示。现有CAD/BIM系统将设计逻辑与几何模型耦合在一起，导致质量保证漂移到下游环节；自动化合规检查（ACC）则受制于几何误报以及依赖命名的模型重建开销。我们提出了工程即代码范式：将工程设计表达为文本原生的声明式语言，并以自动化规则引擎、版本控制和包管理作为质量门禁。核心贡献包括：（1）信息表示假说，论证工程师...
tldr: 提出工程即代码范式，将工程设计表达为文本原生的声明式语言，并配备自动化规则引擎、版本控制和包管理作为质量门禁，为大语言模型参与工程设计建立机器可消费、可验证、可版本化的计算基础。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Engineering as Code (EaC) paradigm, which expresses engineering design as a text-native declarative language with automated rule engines, version control, and package management as quality gates, establishing a machine-consumable, verifiable, and versionable computable foundation for LLMs to tackle engineering design tasks.
